title_en: Amendment (XI) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
Article 17 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Any person who has reached the age of sixteen shall bear criminal liability for any crime he commits.
Any person who has reached the age of fourteen but not the age of sixteen who commits intentional homicide, intentionally inflicts injury causing serious injury or death, rape, robbery, drug trafficking, arson, explosion, or dissemination of dangerous substances shall bear criminal liability.
Any person who has reached the age of twelve but not the age of fourteen who commits intentional homicide or intentional injury, causing death or causing serious injury with extreme cruelty resulting in severe disability, where the circumstances are heinous and prosecution is approved by the Supreme People's Procuratorate, shall bear criminal liability.
Any person under the age of eighteen who is investigated for criminal liability in accordance with the preceding three paragraphs shall be given a lighter or mitigated punishment.
If a person is not subjected to criminal punishment because he has not reached the age of sixteen, his parents or other guardians shall be ordered to discipline him; when necessary, he may be subjected to specialized correctional education according to law."

One article is added after Article 133-1 of the Criminal Law as Article 133-2: "Whoever uses violence against or seizes control of the driving device of a driver of a public transport vehicle in motion, interfering with the normal operation of the public transport vehicle and endangering public safety, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
Any driver as prescribed in the preceding paragraph who, while on a public transport vehicle in motion, abandons his post and engages in mutual assault or assaults others, endangering public safety, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where any act described in the preceding two paragraphs simultaneously constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment."

Paragraph 2 of Article 134 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever forces another person to operate in violation of regulations and take risks, or knowingly fails to eliminate major accident hazards and still organizes operations at risk, thereby causing a major accident involving serious casualties or other serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially flagrant, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years."

Article 141 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever produces or sells counterfeit drugs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if it causes serious harm to human health or if there are other serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if it causes death or if there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or death, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
Where personnel of a drug-using unit knowingly supply counterfeit drugs to another person for use, they shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 142 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever produces or sells substandard drugs, causing serious harm to human health, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the consequences are especially serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
Where personnel of a drug-using unit knowingly supply substandard drugs to another person for use, they shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 160 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, in offering documents such as a prospectus, subscription certificate, or method of fundraising for company or enterprise bonds, conceals important facts or fabricates major false content, and issues stocks or company or enterprise bonds, depository receipts, or other securities recognized according to law by the State Council, where the amount is huge, the consequences are serious, or there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined; where the amount is especially huge, the consequences are especially serious, or there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years and shall also be fined.
Where the controlling shareholder or actual controller organizes or instructs the commission of an act described in the preceding paragraph, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than 20% but not more than one times the amount of illegally raised funds; where the amount is especially huge, the consequences are especially serious, or there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years and shall also be fined not less than 20% but not more than one times the amount of illegally raised funds.
Where a unit commits any of the crimes described in the preceding two paragraphs, the unit shall be fined not less than 20% but not more than one times the amount of illegally raised funds, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable personnel shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph."

Article 161 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a company or enterprise that has a disclosure obligation according to law provides false financial accounting reports or conceals important facts, or fails to disclose other important information that should be disclosed according to law in accordance with regulations, thereby seriously harming the interests of shareholders or other persons, or if there are other serious circumstances, the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable personnel shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined.
Where the controlling shareholder or actual controller of the company or enterprise prescribed in the preceding paragraph commits or organizes or instructs the commission of an act described in the preceding paragraph, or conceals relevant matters resulting in the occurrence of the circumstances described in the preceding paragraph, they shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where the controlling shareholder or actual controller that commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph is a unit, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable personnel shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph."

Paragraph 1 of Article 163 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where an employee of a company, enterprise, or any other unit, taking advantage of his position, demands property from another person or illegally accepts property from another person and seeks benefits for that person, if the amount is relatively large, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge or if there are other serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or if there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined."

Paragraph 1 of Article 175-1 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, by deceptive means, obtains loans, bill acceptance, letters of credit, letters of guarantee, etc., from a bank or any other financial institution, causing significant losses to the bank or other financial institution, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if it causes especially significant losses to the bank or other financial institution or if there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined."

Article 176 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever illegally absorbs or covertly absorbs public deposits, disrupting the financial order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount is huge or if there are other serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or if there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable personnel shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where the person who has committed the acts described in the preceding two paragraphs actively returns the ill-gotten gains and makes restitution before the public prosecution is initiated, thereby reducing the occurrence of harmful consequences, the punishment may be lighter or mitigated."

Article 192 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, for the purpose of illegal possession, raises funds by fraudulent means, if the amount is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge or if there are other serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable personnel shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 200 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a unit commits a crime under Article 194 or Article 195 of this Section, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable personnel shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and may also be fined; if the amount is huge or if there are other serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or if there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined."

Article 213 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, without permission of the owner of a registered trademark, uses a trademark identical to the registered trademark on the same kind of goods or services, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined."

Article 214 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever sells goods that he knows bear a counterfeit registered trademark, where the amount of illegal gains is relatively large or there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years and shall also, or shall only, be fined; where the amount of illegal gains is huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined."

Article 215 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever forges or makes without authorization another person's registered trademark identifier, or sells forged or unauthorized trademark identifiers, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined."

Article 218 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, for the purpose of profit, sells infringing copies that he knows are those specified in Article 217 of this Law, where the amount of illegal gains is huge or there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years and shall also, or shall only, be fined."

One article is added after Article 219 of the Criminal Law as Article 219-1: "Whoever steals, spies on, buys, or illegally provides trade secrets for institutions, organizations, or personnel outside the country shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years and shall also be fined."

Article 220 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a unit commits any of the crimes specified in Articles 213 through 219-1 of this Section, the unit shall be fined, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly liable personnel shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective articles of this Section."

One article is added after Article 236 of the Criminal Law as Article 236-1: "Where a person who has special duties such as guardianship, adoption, care, education, or medical treatment for a female minor who has reached the age of fourteen but not the age of sixteen engages in sexual relations with such minor, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years; if the circumstances are flagrant, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.
Where an act described in the preceding paragraph simultaneously constitutes a crime under Article 236 of this Law, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment."

Paragraph 1 of Article 271 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where an employee of a company, enterprise, or any other unit, taking advantage of his position, unlawfully takes possession of the property of his own unit, if the amount is relatively large, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment and shall also be fined."

Article 272 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where an employee of a company, enterprise, or any other unit, taking advantage of his position, misappropriates the funds of his own unit for personal use or lends them to another person, where the amount is relatively large and not repaid for more than three months, or although not exceeding three months, the amount is relatively large and is used for profit-making activities, or is used for illegal activities, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; where the amount of misappropriated funds is huge, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years; where the amount is especially huge, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years.
Where personnel engaged in public service in a wholly State-owned company, enterprise, or other wholly State-owned unit, or personnel dispatched by a wholly State-owned company, enterprise, or other wholly State-owned unit to engage in public service in a non-wholly State-owned company, enterprise, or other unit commit the act described in the preceding paragraph, they shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 384 of this Law.
Where a person who commits the act described in the first paragraph returns the misappropriated funds before the public prosecution is initiated, the punishment may be lighter or mitigated. If the crime is minor, the punishment may be mitigated or remitted."

Paragraph 5 of Article 277 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever violently attacks a People's Police officer who is lawfully performing his duties shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; where the person uses a firearm, controlled knife, or means such as ramming with a motor vehicle, thereby seriously endangering his personal safety, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years."

One article is added after Article 280-1 of the Criminal Law as Article 280-2: "Whoever steals or uses another person's identity to take the place of that person in obtaining admission qualifications for higher education, civil servant recruitment qualifications, or employment resettlement benefits shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance and shall also be fined.
Whoever organizes or instructs another person to commit the act described in the preceding paragraph shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where a State functionary commits the acts described in the preceding two paragraphs and also constitutes another crime, he shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on combined punishment for several crimes."

One article is added after Article 291-1 of the Criminal Law as Article 291-2: "Whoever throws objects from a building or any other height, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year, criminal detention, or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
Where an act described in the preceding paragraph simultaneously constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment."

One article is added after Article 299 of the Criminal Law as Article 299-1: "Whoever insults, slanders, or otherwise infringes upon the reputation or honor of heroes and martyrs, harming the public interest, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights."

Article 303 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, for the purpose of profit, gathers people to engage in gambling or makes gambling his profession shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance and shall also be fined.
Whoever opens a gambling establishment shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or public surveillance and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined.
Whoever organizes citizens of the People's Republic of China to engage in gambling abroad (outside the country), where the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

One article is added after Article 334 of the Criminal Law as Article 334-1: "Whoever, in violation of relevant State regulations, illegally collects human genetic resources of China or illegally transports, sends by mail, or carries human genetic resource materials of China out of the country, thereby endangering public health or the public interest, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined."

One article is added after Article 336 of the Criminal Law as Article 336-1: "Whoever implants a gene-edited or cloned human embryo into a human or animal body, or implants a gene-edited or cloned animal embryo into a human body, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined."

A third paragraph is added to Article 341 of the Criminal Law: "Whoever, in violation of laws and regulations on wildlife protection and management, for the purpose of consumption, illegally hunts, purchases, transports, or sells terrestrial wild animals that naturally grow and breed in the wild environment other than those specified in the first paragraph, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

One article is added after Article 342 of the Criminal Law as Article 342-1: "Whoever, in violation of laws and regulations on the management of nature reserves, engages in reclamation, development activities, or construction of buildings in a national park or national nature reserve, causing serious consequences or having other flagrant circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined.
Where an act described in the preceding paragraph simultaneously constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment."

One article is added after Article 344 of the Criminal Law as Article 344-1: "Whoever, in violation of State regulations, illegally introduces, releases, or discards invasive alien species, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined."

One article is added after Article 355 of the Criminal Law as Article 355-1: "Whoever induces, instigates, or deceives an athlete into using doping agents to participate in major domestic or international sports competitions, or knowingly provides doping agents to an athlete participating in the aforesaid competitions, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined.
Whoever organizes or forces an athlete to use doping agents to participate in major domestic or international sports competitions shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Paragraph 2 of Article 431 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever steals, spies on, buys, or illegally provides military secrets for institutions, organizations, or personnel outside the country shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years; if the circumstances are serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or death."

Article 450 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "This Chapter shall apply to active-duty officers, civilian cadres, soldiers, and cadets with military status of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, and active-duty officers, civilian cadres, soldiers, and cadets with military status of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force, as well as civilian personnel, reservists performing military tasks, and other personnel."
This Amendment shall come into force on March 1, 2021.
